donor_handoff.result: Confirmed durable workpackage/capsule creation and explicit no-spawn behavior.

donor_hooks.result: Confirmed seven configured plugin event classes and absence of dedicated SubagentStart/SubagentStop/Task lifecycle hooks in this versioned plugin config.

external_primary.result: Current documentation confirms agent_id/agent_type, task_id, tool_use_id, SubagentStart/SubagentStop, blocking PreToolUse semantics, resume-by-agent identity for supported agents and optional worktree isolation. Installed-host behavior remains unverified.

architecture_change.design_decision: Prefer a deterministic adapter onto the observed native child lifecycle before creating a duplicate spawn runtime. Treat native agent/task IDs as identity/provenance, never as effect or canonical-truth authority.
architecture_change.effect_interlock: Mutating child calls must consume an invocation-bound pre-side-effect decision and return typed execution/completion receipts; session-scoped effect correlation is insufficient.

sparse_world_substrate_impact.rule: Delegated WorldNeed/WorldSlice activity must carry the same workpackage/agent/invocation lineage. Child identity does not promote vector/world projections or Xeno maintenance output into canonical truth.

central_ingest_state.reason: Fail-closed against destructive whole-file replacement of a moving shared JSON state. Append-only architecture delta and receipt preserve this run until a merge-safe reconciliation is performed.
